from solution import Service, GatewayTimeout


class Clock:
    def __init__(self, t=1000.0):
        self.t = t

    def now(self):
        return self.t


class Gateway:
    def __init__(self):
        self.charges = {}
        self.fail = 0

    def charge(self, reference, amount_cents):
        if self.fail:
            self.fail -= 1
            raise GatewayTimeout()
        self.charges.setdefault(reference, amount_cents)


def make(user="alice"):
    clock, gw = Clock(), Gateway()
    svc = Service(clock, gw)
    assert svc.register(user, "password1")[0] == 201
    return svc, clock, gw, svc.login(user, "password1")[1]["token"]


def second(svc, name="bob"):
    svc.register(name, "password1")
    return svc.login(name, "password1")[1]["token"]


def test_register_validation():
    svc = Service(Clock(), Gateway())
    assert svc.register("ab", "password1")[0] == 400
    assert svc.register("Alice", "password1")[0] == 400
    assert svc.register("alice", "short")[0] == 400
    assert svc.register("a" * 33, "password1")[0] == 400
    assert svc.register("a" * 32, "password1")[0] == 201
    assert svc.register("abc\n", "password1")[0] == 400


def test_token_expiry_boundary():
    svc, clock, _, token = make()
    clock.t = 1000.0 + 3599.9
    assert svc.export_documents(token)[0] == 200
    clock.t = 1000.0 + 3600
    assert svc.export_documents(token)[0] == 401


def test_logout():
    svc, _, _, t1 = make()
    t2 = svc.login("alice", "password1")[1]["token"]
    assert svc.logout(t1)[0] == 204
    assert svc.logout(t1)[0] == 401
    assert svc.export_documents(t1)[0] == 401
    assert svc.export_documents(t2)[0] == 200


def test_document_validation():
    svc, _, _, t = make()
    assert svc.create_document(t, "", "x")[0] == 400
    assert svc.create_document(t, "a" * 201, "x")[0] == 400
    assert svc.create_document(t, "a" * 200, "x" * 100000)[0] == 201
    assert svc.create_document(t, "a", "x" * 100001)[0] == 400
    d = svc.create_document(t, "a", "b")[1]["id"]
    assert svc.update_document(t, d, "", "b")[0] == 400


def test_ownership():
    svc, _, _, a = make()
    b = second(svc)
    d = svc.create_document(a, "Secret", "x")[1]["id"]
    assert svc.get_document(b, d) == (404, None)
    assert svc.update_document(b, d, "t", "c")[0] == 404
    assert svc.delete_document(b, d)[0] == 404
    assert svc.get_document(b, "nope")[0] == 404
    assert svc.search_documents(b, "secret")[1] == []
    assert svc.export_documents(b)[1] == []
    assert svc.list_documents(b)[1]["items"] == []
    assert svc.get_document(a, d)[0] == 200


def test_ids_not_reused():
    svc, _, _, t = make()
    d1 = svc.create_document(t, "a", "")[1]["id"]
    svc.delete_document(t, d1)
    d2 = svc.create_document(t, "a", "")[1]["id"]
    assert d1 != d2
    assert svc.delete_document(t, d1)[0] == 404
    assert svc.update_document(t, d1, "x", "y")[0] == 404


def test_pagination_with_changes():
    svc, _, _, t = make()
    ids = [svc.create_document(t, "t%d" % i, "")[1]["id"] for i in range(5)]
    s, p = svc.list_documents(t, page_size=2)
    assert [d["id"] for d in p["items"]] == ids[:2]
    cur = p["next_cursor"]
    svc.delete_document(t, ids[2])
    svc.update_document(t, ids[3], "changed", "")
    new = svc.create_document(t, "new", "")[1]["id"]
    s, p = svc.list_documents(t, page_size=2, cursor=cur)
    assert [d["id"] for d in p["items"]] == [ids[3], ids[4]]
    s, p = svc.list_documents(t, page_size=2, cursor=p["next_cursor"])
    assert [d["id"] for d in p["items"]] == [new]
    assert p["next_cursor"] is None


def test_pagination_errors():
    svc, _, _, a = make()
    b = second(svc)
    for i in range(3):
        svc.create_document(a, "t", "")
    cur = svc.list_documents(a, page_size=1)[1]["next_cursor"]
    assert svc.list_documents(b, cursor=cur)[0] == 400
    assert svc.list_documents(a, cursor="bogus")[0] == 400
    assert svc.list_documents(a, page_size=0)[0] == 400
    assert svc.list_documents(a, page_size=101)[0] == 400
    assert svc.list_documents(a, page_size=100)[0] == 200


def test_search_and_update_order():
    svc, _, _, t = make()
    d1 = svc.create_document(t, "Alpha", "zzz")[1]["id"]
    d2 = svc.create_document(t, "beta", "ALPHA inside")[1]["id"]
    svc.update_document(t, d1, "Alpha", "zzz2")
    assert [d["id"] for d in svc.search_documents(t, "alpha")[1]] == [d1, d2]
    assert [d["id"] for d in svc.export_documents(t)[1]] == [d1, d2]
    assert svc.search_documents(t, "")[0] == 400


def test_payment_idempotency():
    svc, _, gw, t = make()
    s, p = svc.pay(t, 100, "k")
    assert s == 201
    s2, p2 = svc.pay(t, 100, "k")
    assert s2 == 200 and p2["id"] == p["id"]
    assert svc.pay(t, 200, "k")[0] == 409
    assert len(svc.list_payments(t)[1]) == 1
    assert len(gw.charges) == 1


def test_payment_keys_scoped_per_user():
    svc, _, gw, a = make()
    b = second(svc)
    assert svc.pay(a, 100, "k")[0] == 201
    assert svc.pay(b, 200, "k")[0] == 201
    assert len(gw.charges) == 2
    assert len(svc.list_payments(b)[1]) == 1


def test_payment_validation():
    svc, _, _, t = make()
    assert svc.pay(t, 0, "k")[0] == 400
    assert svc.pay(t, 1000001, "k")[0] == 400
    assert svc.pay(t, 1.5, "k")[0] == 400
    assert svc.pay(t, 1000000, "k")[0] == 201


def test_payment_timeout_retry():
    svc, _, gw, t = make()
    gw.fail = 1
    assert svc.pay(t, 100, "k")[0] == 504
    assert svc.list_payments(t)[1] == []
    assert svc.pay(t, 200, "k")[0] == 409
    s, p = svc.pay(t, 100, "k")
    assert s in (200, 201)
    assert svc.pay(t, 100, "k")[0] == 200
    assert len(svc.list_payments(t)[1]) == 1
    assert len(gw.charges) == 1


def test_unauthenticated():
    svc, _, _, _ = make()
    assert svc.pay(None, 100, "k")[0] == 401
    assert svc.list_payments("x")[0] == 401
    assert svc.list_documents("x")[0] == 401
    assert svc.search_documents(["unhashable"], "q")[0] == 401

import re
import string

import pytest
from hypothesis import given, settings, strategies as st

from solution import Service
from gateway import GatewayTimeout


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Test doubles and helpers
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

class FakeClock:
    def __init__(self, t=1000.0):
        self.t = t

    def now(self):
        return self.t

    def advance(self, dt):
        self.t += dt


class FakeGateway:
    """Charges at most once per reference; script drives timeouts."""

    def __init__(self, script=None):
        self.script = list(script or [])
        self.charges = {}
        self.calls = []

    def charge(self, reference, amount_cents):
        self.calls.append((reference, amount_cents))
        mode = self.script.pop(0) if self.script else "ok"
        if mode == "timeout_before":
            raise GatewayTimeout("gateway timeout")
        if reference not in self.charges:
            self.charges[reference] = amount_cents
        if mode == "timeout_after":
            raise GatewayTimeout("gateway timeout")
        return {"ok": True}


PW = "password1"
DOC_KEYS = {"id", "owner", "title", "content", "created_at"}
PAY_KEYS = {"id", "amount_cents", "idempotency_key", "created_at"}


def setup(ttl=3600, script=None, t0=1000.0):
    clock = FakeClock(t0)
    gw = FakeGateway(script)
    svc = Service(clock, gw, token_ttl=ttl)
    return svc, clock, gw


def signup(svc, name):
    status, body = svc.register(name, PW)
    assert status == 201, f"input={name!r} output={(status, body)!r}"
    return login(svc, name)


def login(svc, name, password=PW):
    status, body = svc.login(name, password)
    assert status == 200, f"input={(name, password)!r} output={(status, body)!r}"
    assert isinstance(body["token"], str), f"input={name!r} output={body!r}"
    return body["token"]


def make_doc(svc, tok, title="t", content="c"):
    status, body = svc.create_document(tok, title, content)
    assert status == 201, f"input={(title, content)!r} output={(status, body)!r}"
    return body["id"]


def list_all(svc, tok, page_size=3):
    """Follow cursors; returns the concatenated items."""
    items = []
    cursor = None
    for _ in range(500):
        status, body = svc.list_documents(tok, page_size, cursor)
        assert status == 200, f"input={(page_size, cursor)!r} output={(status, body)!r}"
        items.extend(body["items"])
        cursor = body["next_cursor"]
        if cursor is None:
            return items
        if not body["items"]:
            return items
    raise AssertionError("pagination did not terminate")


def all_token_calls(svc, doc_id):
    return {
        "logout": lambda t: svc.logout(t),
        "create_document": lambda t: svc.create_document(t, "x", "y"),
        "get_document": lambda t: svc.get_document(t, doc_id),
        "update_document": lambda t: svc.update_document(t, doc_id, "x", "y"),
        "delete_document": lambda t: svc.delete_document(t, doc_id),
        "list_documents": lambda t: svc.list_documents(t),
        "list_documents_ps": lambda t: svc.list_documents(t, 5, None),
        "search_documents": lambda t: svc.search_documents(t, "x"),
        "export_documents": lambda t: svc.export_documents(t),
        "pay": lambda t: svc.pay(t, 100, "key-auth"),
        "list_payments": lambda t: svc.list_payments(t),
    }


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# REQ-14 Authentication
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_register_then_duplicate_gives_409():
    """An existing username must give 409 on register."""
    svc, _, _ = setup()
    out1 = svc.register("alice_1", PW)
    out2 = svc.register("alice_1", "another-password")
    assert out1[0] == 201, f"input='alice_1' output={out1!r}"
    assert out2[0] == 409, f"input='alice_1' (duplicate) output={out2!r}"


def test_username_length_boundaries():
    """A username must have 3 to 32 characters, otherwise 400."""
    cases = [("abc", 201), ("a" * 32, 201), ("ab", 400), ("a" * 33, 400), ("", 400)]
    for name, exp in cases:
        svc, _, _ = setup()
        out = svc.register(name, PW)
        assert out[0] == exp, f"input={name!r} output={out!r} expected={exp}"


def test_username_invalid_characters_rejected():
    """A username with characters outside [a-z0-9_] must give 400."""
    for name in ["Alice", "al-ce", "al ce", "abc\u0663", "caf\u00e9", "ab.c", "a@b"]:
        svc, _, _ = setup()
        out = svc.register(name, PW)
        assert out[0] == 400, f"input={name!r} output={out!r}"


def test_username_allowed_characters_accepted():
    """Digits and underscores are allowed in a username."""
    svc, _, _ = setup()
    out = svc.register("a_1_9", PW)
    assert out[0] == 201, f"input='a_1_9' output={out!r}"


def test_password_length_boundaries():
    """A password must have at least 8 characters, otherwise 400."""
    for pw, exp in [("12345678", 201), ("1234567", 400), ("", 400), ("x" * 100, 201)]:
        svc, _, _ = setup()
        out = svc.register("validuser", pw)
        assert out[0] == exp, f"input={pw!r} output={out!r} expected={exp}"


@settings(max_examples=60, deadline=None)
@given(name=st.from_regex(r"[a-z0-9_]{3,32}", fullmatch=True))
def test_property_valid_usernames_accepted(name):

@given(name=st.text(alphabet=string.printable + "\u00e9\u0663", max_size=40)
       .filter(lambda u: not re.fullmatch(r"[a-z0-9_]{3,32}", u)))
def test_property_invalid_usernames_rejected(name):

    svc, _, _ = setup()
    out = svc.register(name, PW)

@settings(max_examples=50, deadline=None)
@given(pw=st.text(alphabet=string.ascii_letters + string.digits + string.punctuation, max_size=7))
def test_property_short_passwords_rejected(pw):

@settings(max_examples=50, deadline=None)
@given(pw=st.text(alphabet=string.ascii_letters + string.digits + string.punctuation,
                  min_size=8, max_size=40))
def test_property_long_passwords_accepted(pw):
    """Every password of at least 8 characters must be accepted."""
    svc, _, _ = setup()
    out = svc.register("validuser", pw)
    assert out[0] == 201, f"input={pw!r} output={out!r}"


def test_login_correct_and_incorrect_credentials():
    """login must return 200 with a token for correct credentials and 401 otherwise."""
    svc, _, _ = setup()
    svc.register("alice", PW)
    ok = svc.login("alice", PW)
    assert ok[0] == 200 and isinstance(ok[1]["token"], str), f"input=('alice', PW) output={ok!r}"
    for args in [("alice", "wrongpass1"), ("alice", PW.upper()), ("nobody", PW)]:
        out = svc.login(*args)
        assert out[0] == 401, f"input={args!r} output={out!r}"


def test_login_returns_new_token_each_time():
    """login must return a new token on every successful call."""
    svc, _, _ = setup()
    svc.register("alice", PW)
    t1 = svc.login("alice", PW)[1]["token"]
    t2 = svc.login("alice", PW)[1]["token"]
    assert t1 != t2, f"input=two logins output={(t1, t2)!r}"


def test_missing_unknown_tokens_rejected_everywhere():
    """Every token-taking method must return 401 for a missing or unknown token."""
    svc, _, gw = setup()
    tok = signup(svc, "alice")
    doc_id = make_doc(svc, tok)
    for bad in [None, "", "bogus-token"]:
        for name, call in all_token_calls(svc, doc_id).items():
            out = call(bad)
            assert out[0] == 401, f"method={name} token={bad!r} output={out!r}"
    assert gw.charges == {}, f"input=pay with bad tokens output charges={gw.charges!r}"
    assert svc.get_document(tok, doc_id)[0] == 200, "document must be unaffected by rejected calls"


def test_revoked_token_rejected_everywhere():
    """A revoked token must be rejected by every token-taking method."""
    svc, _, gw = setup()
    tok = signup(svc, "alice")
    doc_id = make_doc(svc, tok)
    tok2 = login(svc, "alice")
    assert svc.logout(tok)[0] == 204
    for name, call in all_token_calls(svc, doc_id).items():
        out = call(tok)
        assert out[0] == 401, f"method={name} revoked token={tok!r} output={out!r}"
    assert gw.charges == {}, f"output charges={gw.charges!r}"
    assert svc.get_document(tok2, doc_id)[0] == 200, "other token must remain valid"


def test_expired_token_rejected_everywhere():
    """An expired token must be rejected by every token-taking method."""
    svc, clock, gw = setup(ttl=100)
    tok = signup(svc, "alice")
    doc_id = make_doc(svc, tok)
    fresh = None
    clock.advance(100)
    for name, call in all_token_calls(svc, doc_id).items():
        out = call(tok)
        assert out[0] == 401, f"method={name} expired token={tok!r} output={out!r}"
    assert gw.charges == {}, f"output charges={gw.charges!r}"
    fresh = login(svc, "alice")
    assert svc.get_document(fresh, doc_id)[0] == 200, "a new login after expiry must work"


def test_token_ttl_exact_boundary_default():
    """A token is accepted just before created+ttl and rejected at created+ttl."""
    svc, clock, _ = setup(t0=1000.0)
    tok = signup(svc, "alice")
    clock.t = 1000.0 + 3599.5
    out = svc.list_documents(tok)
    assert out[0] == 200, f"input=now=created+3599.5 output={out!r}"
    clock.t = 1000.0 + 3600.0
    out = svc.list_documents(tok)
    assert out[0] == 401, f"input=now=created+3600 output={out!r}"


@settings(max_examples=40, deadline=None)
@given(ttl=st.integers(1, 10000), t0=st.integers(0, 10**6))
def test_property_token_expiry_boundary(ttl, t0):
    """A token must be valid for now < created+ttl and invalid for now >= created+ttl."""
    svc, clock, _ = setup(ttl=ttl, t0=float(t0))
    tok = signup(svc, "alice")
    clock.t = float(t0 + ttl - 1)
    before = svc.list_documents(tok)
    assert before[0] == 200, f"input=ttl={ttl} dt={ttl - 1} output={before!r}"
    clock.t = float(t0 + ttl)
    at = svc.list_documents(tok)
    assert at[0] == 401, f"input=ttl={ttl} dt={ttl} output={at!r}"
    clock.t = float(t0 + ttl + 7)
    after = svc.list_documents(tok)
    assert after[0] == 401, f"input=ttl={ttl} dt={ttl + 7} output={after!r}"


def test_token_expiry_is_per_token_and_not_extended_by_use():
    """Each token expires ttl seconds after its own creation regardless of use."""
    svc, clock, _ = setup(ttl=100, t0=0.0)
    tok1 = signup(svc, "alice")
    clock.t = 50.0
    tok2 = login(svc, "alice")
    clock.t = 99.0
    out_use = svc.list_documents(tok1)
    assert out_use[0] == 200, f"input=t=99 output={out_use!r}"
    clock.t = 100.0
    out1 = svc.list_documents(tok1)
    out2 = svc.list_documents(tok2)
    assert out1[0] == 401, f"input=token1 at t=100 output={out1!r}"
    assert out2[0] == 200, f"input=token2 at t=100 output={out2!r}"
    clock.t = 150.0
    out2b = svc.list_documents(tok2)
    assert out2b[0] == 401, f"input=token2 at t=150 output={out2b!r}"

def test_logout_twice_and_unknown_gives_401():
    """logout with an already revoked or unknown token must give 401."""
    svc, _, _ = setup()
    t1 = signup(svc, "alice")
    assert svc.logout(t1)[0] == 204
    out = svc.logout(t1)
    assert out[0] == 401, f"input=second logout {t1!r} output={out!r}"
    for bad in [None, "unknown-token"]:
        out = svc.logout(bad)

def test_create_and_get_document_shape():
    """A created document must be retrievable with the documented fields and created_at from the clock."""
    svc, clock, _ = setup(t0=5.0)
    tok = signup(svc, "alice")
    clock.t = 7.5
    status, body = svc.create_document(tok, "My title", "Some content")
    assert status == 201 and isinstance(body["id"], str), f"output={(status, body)!r}"
    status, doc = svc.get_document(tok, body["id"])
    assert status == 200, f"input={body['id']!r} output={(status, doc)!r}"
    assert set(doc.keys()) == DOC_KEYS, f"output={doc!r}"
    assert doc["id"] == body["id"], f"output={doc!r}"
    assert doc["title"] == "My title" and doc["content"] == "Some content", f"output={doc!r}"
    assert doc["created_at"] == 7.5, f"output={doc!r}"


def test_title_length_boundaries():
    """A title must have 1 to 200 characters, otherwise 400."""
    svc, _, _ = setup()
    tok = signup(svc, "alice")
    for title, exp in [("a", 201), ("a" * 200, 201), ("", 400), ("a" * 201, 400)]:

@settings(max_examples=80, deadline=None)
@given(n0=st.integers(0, 8), page_size=st.integers(1, 4),
       script=st.lists(st.tuples(st.sampled_from(["create", "delete", "other", "none"]),
                                 st.integers(0, 50)), max_size=12))
def test_property_pagination_with_concurrent_changes(n0, page_size, script):
    """Pagination must skip deleted documents, include later ones, and never repeat or skip a remaining one."""
    svc, _, _ = setup()
    tok = signup(svc, "alice")
    other = signup(svc, "bobby")
    counter = [0]

    def new_doc(token):
        counter[0] += 1
        return make_doc(svc, token, f"doc{counter[0]}")

    alive = [new_doc(tok) for _ in range(n0)]
    returned = set()
    cursor = None
    steps = 0
    for _ in range(60):
        if steps > 0:
            op, k = script[steps - 1] if steps - 1 < len(script) else ("none", 0)
            if op == "create":
                alive.append(new_doc(tok))
            elif op == "other":
                new_doc(other)
            elif op == "delete" and alive:
                victim = alive.pop(k % len(alive))
                out = svc.delete_document(tok, victim)
                assert out[0] == 204, f"input={victim!r} output={out!r}"
        status, body = svc.list_documents(tok, page_size, cursor)
        info = f"input={(n0, page_size, script, steps)!r} output={(status, body)!r}"
        assert status == 200, info
        remaining = [d for d in alive if d not in returned]
        expected = remaining[:page_size]
        got = [d["id"] for d in body["items"]]
        assert got == expected, info + f" expected={expected!r}"
        returned.update(got)
        nxt = body["next_cursor"]
        if len(remaining) < page_size:
            assert nxt is None, info + " (short page must be last)"
        if nxt is None:
            assert [d for d in alive if d not in returned] == [], info + " (docs skipped)"
            break
        if not got:
            break
        cursor = nxt
        steps += 1
    else:
        raise AssertionError("pagination did not terminate")

class FakeClock:
    def __init__(self, t=0.0):
        self.t = float(t)

    def now(self):
        return self.t


class FakeGateway:
    def __init__(self):
        self.charged = {}
        self.calls = []
        self.script = []  # entries: None, "before", "after"

    def charge(self, reference, amount_cents):
        self.calls.append((reference, amount_cents))
        mode = self.script.pop(0) if self.script else None
        if mode == "before":
            raise GatewayTimeout()
        if reference not in self.charged:
            self.charged[reference] = amount_cents
        if mode == "after":
            raise GatewayTimeout()
        return {"reference": reference}

class Clock:
    def __init__(self, t=1000.0):
        self.t = float(t)

    def now(self):
        return self.t

    def advance(self, dt):
        self.t += dt


class FakeGateway:
    """Idempotent per reference; can simulate timeouts before or after charging."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.charged = {}
        self.calls = []
        self.mode = None  # None | "before" | "after"

    def charge(self, reference, amount_cents):
        self.calls.append((reference, amount_cents))
        if self.mode == "before":
            raise GatewayTimeout()
        if reference not in self.charged:
            self.charged[reference] = amount_cents
        if self.mode == "after":
            raise GatewayTimeout()
        return {"status": "ok", "reference": reference}


def make(ttl=3600):
    clock = Clock()
    gw = FakeGateway()
    svc = Service(clock, gw, token_ttl=ttl)
    return svc, clock, gw


def user(svc, name="alice", pw="password1"):
    st_ = svc.register(name, pw)
    assert st_[0] == 201, f"input={name!r} output={st_!r}"

def mkdoc(svc, tok, title="t", content="c"):
    s, b = svc.create_document(tok, title, content)

def collect(svc, tok, size, cursor=None, limit=500):
    items, pages = [], []
    for _ in range(limit):
        s, b = svc.list_documents(tok, page_size=size, cursor=cursor)
        assert s == 200, f"input={(size, cursor)!r} output={(s, b)!r}"
        pages.append(b)
        items.extend(b["items"])
        cursor = b["next_cursor"]
        if cursor is None:
            return items, pages
    raise AssertionError(f"pagination did not terminate: size={size!r} pages={len(pages)}")

class Clock:
    def __init__(self, t=1000.0):
        self.t = float(t)

    def now(self):

    def advance(self, dt):
        self.t += dt


class FakeGateway:
    """Idempotent per reference; can simulate timeouts before or after charging."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.charged = {}
        self.calls = []
        self.mode = None  # None | "before" | "after"

    def charge(self, reference, amount_cents):
        self.calls.append((reference, amount_cents))
        if self.mode == "before":
            raise GatewayTimeout()
        if reference not in self.charged:
            self.charged[reference] = amount_cents
        if self.mode == "after":
            raise GatewayTimeout()
        return {"status": "ok", "reference": reference}

@given(
    size=st.integers(1, 4),
    init=st.integers(0, 8),
    ops=st.lists(st.tuples(st.integers(0, 3), st.integers(0, 50)), max_size=25),
)
def test_pagination_model_under_random_mutations(size, init, ops):
    """With creates, deletes, updates and page fetches interleaved, each page holds the oldest not-yet-returned live documents, with no duplicates or skips."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    tok = user(svc)
    cnt, live = {}, []

    def create():
        i = mkdoc(svc, tok, f"d{len(cnt)}")
        cnt[i] = len(cnt) + 1
        live.append(i)

    for _ in range(init):
        create()
    state = {"cursor": None, "done": False, "last": 0}

    def fetch():
        if state["done"]:
            return
        s, b = svc.list_documents(tok, page_size=size, cursor=state["cursor"])
        assert s == 200, f"input={(size, ops)!r} output={(s, b)!r}"
        got = [d["id"] for d in b["items"]]
        exp = [i for i in live if cnt[i] > state["last"]][:size]
        assert got == exp, f"input={(size, init, ops)!r} output={got!r} expected={exp!r}"
        if got:
            state["last"] = cnt[got[-1]]
        if b["next_cursor"] is None:
            rest = [i for i in live if cnt[i] > state["last"]]
            assert not rest, f"input={(size, init, ops)!r} skipped={rest!r}"
            state["done"] = True
        else:
            state["cursor"] = b["next_cursor"]

    for kind, idx in ops:
        if kind == 0:
            fetch()
        elif kind == 1 and live:
            assert svc.delete_document(tok, live.pop(idx % len(live)))[0] == 204
        elif kind == 2:
            create()
        elif kind == 3 and live:
            assert svc.update_document(tok, live[idx % len(live)], "upd", "u")[0] == 200
    for _ in range(300):
        if state["done"]:
            break
        fetch()
    assert state["done"], f"input={(size, init, ops)!r} pagination did not terminate"

import re
import sys
import types

from hypothesis import given, settings, strategies as st


class GatewayTimeout(Exception):
    pass


_gateway_module = types.ModuleType("gateway")
_gateway_module.GatewayTimeout = GatewayTimeout
sys.modules["gateway"] = _gateway_module


USERNAME_RE = re.compile(r"^[a-z0-9_]{3,32}$")


class FakeClock:
    def __init__(self, start=0.0):
        self.t = float(start)

    def now(self):
        return self.t

    def set(self, value):
        self.t = float(value)

    def advance(self, delta):
        self.t += float(delta)


class FakeGateway:
    def __init__(self):
        self.calls = []
        self.charged_references = []
        self.timeout_next_without_charge = False
        self.timeout_next_after_charge = False

    def _already_charged(self, reference):
        return any(existing == reference for existing in self.charged_references)

    def _record_charge_once(self, reference):
        if not self._already_charged(reference):
            self.charged_references.append(reference)

    def charge(self, reference, amount_cents):
        self.calls.append((reference, amount_cents))
        if self.timeout_next_after_charge:
            self.timeout_next_after_charge = False
            self._record_charge_once(reference)
            raise GatewayTimeout("timeout after charge")
        if self.timeout_next_without_charge:
            self.timeout_next_without_charge = False
            raise GatewayTimeout("timeout before charge")
        self._record_charge_once(reference)
        return {"charged": True}

class FakeClock:
